title: Kagamine Rin — Unheard Voice〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Hi. Hehe...
That felt a little strange, since we're always the ones welcoming you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Since you're here, please make yourselves at home.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay. It's nice to spend time together like this...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Len, we're not here to hang out with her.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Our job is to keep an eye on Kanade to make sure she gets plenty of rest.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<R-Right...
Sorry, I promise to do my job.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I need to leave for school soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Keep an eye on Kanade for me, you three.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, yes. Mafuyu and I just had breakfast before you all came.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <In that case, go to bed. You're not allowed to get up unless you need to use the bathroom or get a snack, or a drink of water.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, did Mafuyu tell you to say that?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, they want you to rest as much as possible right now...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'll rest as much as I can today.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Are you feeling cold at all, Kanade?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Do you think you'll be able to fall asleep...?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Get plenty of rest...
Try to forget that we're even here.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, umm...
I just remembered Mafuyu's story from when she was little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If I can recreate the experience of being nursed back to health, maybe I'll be able to feel the same warmth that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <No more thinking about that. Go to sleep.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This feels a bit strange, is all...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The fact that you're all so worried about me that you're willing to scold me like this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Of course we're worried. So, go to sleep.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you two as well, Miku, Len.
Good night.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I'm staying here until Mafuyu gets back.
You two can return without me.>
